summary: Built the complete ORI-RN-005 NativeWind live-example proof stack: tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/nativewind-live-example.ts (runNativewindLiveExampleProof + CLI with --platforms/--case/--manifest/--out), the five-mapping nativewind-live-source-manifest.json, the ai@7.0.89 + @ai-sdk/react@4.0.92 hook pins in the nested nativewind package.json, and the four named vitest proofs. Everything in scope ran for real and is green: the fresh consumer materializes outside the monorepo from ORI-RN-001's template, the verbatim public recipe installs the registry items from rnraielements.com, all 5 source/target SHA-256 pairs copy byte-identical, the hook pins resolve, expo-doctor passes 21/21, uniwind stays absent, and AC-4 is vitest-green (tampered hash fails closed naming path+expected+actual before any launch; absent target fails closed naming the exact UDID selector with teardown proving the backend stopped; the blocked run's teardown shows appearances restored, consumer removed, zero adb reverses). pnpm typecheck, biome ci (via the direct binary — the pnpm wrapper OOMs locally, a known machine quirk), and check:fallow all exit 0. AC-1/AC-2/AC-3 cannot go green inside this task's write scope: the consumer's real compiler rejects the byte-identical canonical sources with exactly two errors — live-chat-screen.tsx:5 'Cannot find module uniwind' (TS2307) and live-chat-screen.tsx:21 'THEME' is declared locally but not exported (TS2459) — so the three live legs are honestly 'blocked' at the compile gate and never launched on devices. RED/GREEN logs and receipts are retained under .tmp/ORI-RN-005/ and tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-RN-005/ (manifest.json, install receipts, teardown.json, README naming the rerun command).
assumptions: The AC-4 'absent target' negative control is exercised by spawning the real driver with RNR_S05_IOS_UDID pointed at a UDID that simctl genuinely does not list (reserveDevices then fails naming the exact selector before any consumer build) — the reserved physical devices themselves are only used by the (compile-blocked) live legs.

The driver ports (backend 4010 / Metro 8097 / web 8408) were chosen distinct from ORI-RN-004's 4000/8095/8406 so ORI-AI-002 can run both engine drivers concurrently; nothing in the contract pins port numbers.

The task lint command 'pnpm exec biome ci ...' fails locally with 'Linter process terminated abnormally' even on --version (documented machine quirk); ./node_modules/.bin/biome ci with identical paths exits 0 and matches CI's verdict, so that was used as the lint gate.

AC-2's 'at least 2 distinct nonempty assistant text lengths before completion' is implemented as a mid-stream sampler (native: longest accessibility-tree text sampled every ~1.5s between send and the terminal backend record; web: DOM transcript length every ~500ms), since the legs could not run this cycle the sampler is verified only by construction, not execution.
blockers: apps/example/components/live-chat-screen.tsx line 5: 'import { useUniwind } from "uniwind"' — the canonical screen is authored against the Uniwind engine's theme hook and cannot compile in the NativeWind consumer, where the task contract forbids adding uniwind ('never adds Uniwind to the consumer', DELIVERABLE: package.json 'adds only verified exact live-hook packages') and forbids declaration shims. One-line fix owned by ORI-RN-004 (apps/example/** is writeProhibited here): use React Native's useColorScheme instead (the hook's only use is theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light' for THEME[mode].background).

packages/docs-snippets/nativewind/lib/theme.ts: 'const THEME = {…}' is not exported while the canonical screen imports { THEME } from '@/lib/theme' (apps/example's own lib/theme.ts exports it). One-word fix owned by ORI-RN-001 (packages/docs-snippets/nativewind/** except package.json is writeProhibited here): change 'const THEME' to 'export const THEME'. Both fixes land, then rerun: pnpm exec tsx tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/nativewind-live-example.ts --platforms ios,android,web — the driver, tests, manifest and evidence plumbing are complete and waiting.

scope_impact.found: The task contract is internally unsatisfiable as written: it demands five byte-identical canonical sources ('5 source/target SHA-256 pairs match') compiling in the prescribed NativeWind consumer, but one prescribed source statically imports the uniwind engine hook and imports a symbol the prescribed ORI-RN-001 template does not export. Verified empirically — the real recipe + tsc produce exactly TS2307 ('uniwind') and TS2459 (THEME not exported) and nothing else; the planner's 2026-09-14 proposal predates the screen's landing shape (at planning SHA 38034e97 neither file existed).
scope_impact.change: Everything except those two one-line upstream edits was built, run for real, and committed (AC-4 green, gates green); route the two edits to ORI-RN-004 (screen) and ORI-RN-001 (template export), after which the blocked legs rerun without any further work in this task's files.
